create_GotOcr2ImageProcessor: create a GotOcr2ImageProcessor instance with custom crop_to_patches, min_patches, and max_patches settings
run_crop_image_to_patches: run crop_image_to_patches to split an image tensor into optimal grid patches with a thumbnail
run_preprocess: run preprocess to resize, crop to patches, rescale, and normalize image tensors for GOT-OCR2 input
build_optimal_tiled_canvas: build an optimal tiled canvas grid that matches the original image aspect ratio within tile constraints
get_number_of_image_patches: get the number of image patches for a given image height and width with optional patch config overrides
